comment: FINDING, kept as a regression: against Marth's down tilt the same waveshine up smash is NOT reachable: the shine slides Marth ~46 units (set knockback, so percent does not matter) while Fox's waveland covers ~22. Shine OoS then waveshine up smash vs Marth down tilt at 20%: the aerial shine OoS lands into the grounded shine loop (0x169); jump out of it the frame after landing (delay 1: a landing happens after the frame's input is read), airdodge with L (R is held for the shield) down-toward 4 frames after the jump squat starts (the first frame Fox can act in the air) (wavedash toward Marth, on the left), then up smash when the 10-frame landing lag ends.
